How to Bloom

Drag anywhere (or WASD / arrows) to fly. A hidden painting lies under the gray world — your brush reveals it.
Reveal the listed picture regions (e.g. Whale) to 85% for +12s and a full ink refill.
Painting uses ink. Fly through glowing ink wells to refill — they recharge slowly. No ink = slow and colorless.
Keep painting nonstop to build a combo. Fill the Bloom bar to grow through 5 stages.
Smog blobs un-paint the world and drain ink. Dash (Space / double-tap / DASH) bursts them from Bloom 3.
Win: paint the target % and purify the Smog Heart — dash into it at Bloom 4+ — before time runs out.
